Messages.Body:
Accronym lovers and V:TES players: our game needs your helps slaying
the lumbering CCG behemoth of Magic.

http://www.boardgamegeek.com/geeklist/22417/item/441218#item441218

The mighty V:TES has got to the last 4 of the ultimate CCG challenge
on Board Game Geek and we need more bodies to throw into the breach.
We need, thumbs, people: thumbs.

We need to crush Magic much like the way V:TES abused and soiled
Middle Earth: the Wizards in the last round and, before that, sent the
shocking cardboard horror that was the BattleTech CCG back to the
darkest reaches of the web where it rightfully belongs (until such
time that all the remaining cards have been burned and its remaining
player found and violated with a spork).

For victory! At least until the inevitable defeat by Netrunner in the
final!

Matt Green
